name: Stunt Dirt Bike
author: Addicting Games
description: Stunt Bike Driver is a racing game. Put your dirt bike skills to the test by making it through each short obstacle course as quickly as possible and without wiping out in this 2D game. These trials of skill will certainly put your dirt bike or ATV skills to the test. In theory, it’s simple—make it from one side of the screen to the other, but this is certainly something that’s easier said than done. What kind of obstacle course would it be if there were no obstacles, and there are obstacles-a-plenty. And as the old tortoise taught us, sometimes to win a race, it’s better to go slow than fast, especially when going fast will send you tumbling over an obstacle and onto your head. ree.
